question.problem:
Determine the number of pivot columns of the matrix $P,$ given by

$$
P=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 2 & 7 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -6 & 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -2 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
First, we need to convert $P$ to row echelon form:

$$
\begin{aligned}P & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 2 & 7 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -6 & 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -2 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+2{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 2 & 7 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -2 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 2 & 7 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 & 5\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Looking at the row echelon form, we see that $P$ has $4$ pivots, and therefore the number of pivot columns is $4.$
